title: New image dataset aims to improve AI-based navigation of PV cleaning robots
summary: Researchers have created a dataset of 6,200 solar panel images designed to support AI-based navigation of cleaning robots. The dataset features annotated panel reference lines under clean, synthetically soiled, and laboratory contamination conditions, with the aim of helping developers assess the robustness of visual navigation algorithms. The post New image dataset aims to improve AI-based navigation of PV cleaning robots appeared first on pv magazine Global .
